description: This file contains shell script functions for platform-specific operations, including firmware identification, upgrade procedures, and hardware-specific utilities for BCM4908-based devices. It includes functions for reading firmware content, verifying images, and performing complex upgrade sequences involving UBI and NAND flash.

methods.name: get_content
methods.description: Reads specific byte content from a file at a given offset with a specified length.

methods.name: get_hex_u32_le
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a specified offset and returns the value in little-endian hexadecimal format.

methods.name: get_hex_u32_be
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a specified offset and returns the value in big-endian hexadecimal format.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Returns the expected device model name based on the current board.

methods.name: platform_identify
methods.description: Identifies the firmware format and extracts key information from the firmware image, such as format type, board ID, and internal image format.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_get_image_name
methods.description: Retrieves the image name from a pkgtb firmware file based on configurations.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_get_image
methods.description: Extracts the image data from pkgtb firmware files, handling various internal structures.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_get_upgrade_index
methods.description: Determines the UBI upgrade index based on an environment variable.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_commit
methods.description: Commits changes to the pkgtb environment variables, updating the firmware's committed state.

methods.name: platform_check_pkgtb
methods.description: Validates the presence of specific images within a pkgtb firmware file.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation of the firmware image, checking format, device compatibility, and specific contents as required.

methods.name: platform_pkgtb_clean_rootfs_data
methods.description: Verifies and cleans the root filesystem data in the UBI environment.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_pkgtb
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade specifically for pkgtb formatted images, handling UBI volumes and environment updates.

methods.name: platform_calc_new_cferam
methods.description: Calculates a new cferam index by incrementing the current one modulo 1000 to facilitate firmware versioning.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_ubi
methods.description: Handles UBI-based firmware upgrade process including verifying sizes, renaming cferam, copying root filesystem, and flashing partitions.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher that identifies image format and calls respective upgrade functions or falls back to raw flashing.
